name: NOAA CPC
note: Verified advisory dated 12 November 2026. Niño 3.4 weekly index is not ONI or RONI.

name: NISAR / ASF DAAC
note: Validated L0–L2 released 6 November for acquisitions from 21 October 2026. Provisional acquisitions begin 17 June; earlier beta data exist. Record maturity and processing version.
status: Regional browse available; quantitative observations pending

name: NISAR GCOV
note: Terrain-corrected gamma-zero power. Read only the polarizations present. A diagonal covariance element is converted to dB with 10 log10(power).

name: NISAR known issues
note: Review known issues for the exact maturity, processing version and acquisition period before interpreting change.

name: ASF search
note: Public metadata search. Scientific HDF5 downloads require Earthdata Login. Browse images are regional contrast-stretched quicklooks, not calibrated pixel values.

name: Open-Meteo / ECMWF ERA5
note: Daily temperature and precipitation reanalysis. Request models=era5, timezone=UTC and a seven-day publication buffer. CC BY 4.0 attribution; noncommercial free API limits apply.

name: Open-Meteo terms
note: Free noncommercial API: fewer than 10,000 calls/day, 5,000/hour and 600/minute. Institutional or commercial deployments must review the service terms.

name: NASA GIBS
note: WMS 1.1.1 with EPSG:4326, longitude/latitude BBOX, dated MODIS Terra true color. Optical context, not a SAR product.

name: Sentinel-1 / ASF
note: Use radiometrically terrain-corrected, comparable Sentinel-1 scenes for a longer baseline. Never subtract C-band and L-band observations as equivalent measurements.

name: OPERA DSWx-S1
note: 30 m categorical surface-water maps with confidence information. Use water classes as water classes, not as dB. Inspect product version and known anomalies.

name: ESA WorldCover
note: 2020 and 2021 use different algorithms; a difference between them is not necessarily a land-cover change. CC BY 4.0.

name: WorldPop
note: Population estimates are context, not observed counts of people affected. Record product, year and license with the downloaded layer.

name: Copernicus DEM
note: A digital surface model including vegetation and buildings. Keep the required product attribution and license.

name: GDELT DOC 2.0
note: Build-time headline discovery with source links. A live probe returned HTTP 429; cached news is retained on errors. No article bodies are republished.

name: VADER
note: Hutto & Gilbert (2014). Raw VADER plus a separately labeled climate-adjusted lexicon. The project override is a heuristic, not a validated climate classifier.

name: Photon / OpenStreetMap
note: Explicit search only, maximum five results. Public demo service is best effort and may throttle. OpenStreetMap attribution applies.

name: NASA POWER
note: An alternative meteorological source, reviewed but not mixed into the ERA5 charts. At most 20 parameters per point request; preserve UTC/LST distinction.

name: Natural Earth / world-atlas 2.0.2
note: Pinned small-scale locator boundaries. Natural Earth public-domain geography; world-atlas ISC license included. Not authoritative local geometry.
